name: Head In The Stars
source:
Head In The Stars is a first-person visual novel where the main character meets a personified shooting star, and learns about life beyond the cosmos.

[From [url=https://alkiaa.itch.io/hits]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Head In The Stars》是一部第一人称视觉小说。主角邂逅了一颗化作人形的流星，并了解到宇宙之外的生活。

[摘自[url=https://alkiaa.itch.io/hits]itch.io[/url]]
